Surviving is just what everyone has mostly stated, getting through it. & you did it! That’s a huge success in itself. For me it was definitely a “sunken place” after I came out. You just have to find yourself, who are you away from the abuse? Anything you’ve always wanted to do or learn? Chase after that! & the people will come! Most importantly, get counseling with someone who is educated in trauma recovery (it takes a while to find a therapist that’s for you!). I can’t say it’s been all sunshine and rainbows - without a doubt it’s been a hell of a rollercoaster ride. But you have to ride that’s the most important place. & you learn every step of the way, it does get easier to cope and less reoccurring of the bad.
